C-CARGO-WORKSPACE-CACHE.Summary: Align the three existing Cargo build caches with the root Cargo workspace target directory.
C-CARGO-WORKSPACE-CACHE.Problem: Original audit record CI:F-003 is confirmed on main a504783a98b9aa8ff5b1b388689ba2f1af114b3c. Locked offline cargo metadata resolves the target directory to the repository-root target, but the explicit caches in test.yml, release.yml and release-tauri.yml preserve src-tauri/target. The configured cache misses the workspace build products.

Goals.Goal: Preserve and restore the root workspace target in all three existing explicit Cargo caches, alongside their existing registry and Git dependency paths.
Give the corrected target layout a distinct cache-key namespace while retaining each current OS/target split, rust-toolchain.toml and Cargo.lock key inputs.
Keep correctness checks and release authorization independent of cache availability, and report actual restore/reuse evidence without inventing a speed improvement.

Constraints.Constraint: Change only the three affected cache path/key declarations and directly related stale path descriptions. Preserve tool versions, platforms, dependencies, build/test commands, checks, budgets, retries, skips, coverage floors, signing boundaries and publication controls.

Verification adds only tests/tools/cargo-workspace-cache.test.mjs with parsed workflow/controlled cache fixtures; it does not build Cargo, contact cache services, execute actions or require Rust in the renderer unit runner.
Use Cargo's existing root workspace layout. Do not move sources, set a new CARGO_TARGET_DIR, merge platform caches, clean shared caches or change production artifact paths.
Release workflow execution, signing and publication remain separately authorized. Source checks and ordinary PR backend runs do not prove a live production release-cache hit.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No compiler/dependency upgrade, cache service replacement, new runner, remote compiler cache, release redesign, automatic dispatch or version/tag change.
No signing-boundary C-50 work, QA installer upload changes or edits to frozen/archived history.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Locked offline cargo metadata and parsed workflow declarations agree that every affected target cache is the root target; registry/Git paths and per-platform key isolation remain present.
The corrected layout cannot restore an old member-target cache through a legacy restore prefix. Existing toolchain/lock identity inputs remain in the key, without source-by-source invalidation.
Applicable existing workflow/release boundary tests and action/reference validation pass; exact-candidate ordinary PR backend jobs prove compilation and tests on the supported operating systems.

Use a normal authorized subsequent CI run to record target save/restore and actual Cargo reuse where available. Keep unexecuted release-cache and measured-performance evidence explicit; do not dispatch a release merely to test a cache.

Maintain M-046/V-M-046 projections and pass GRACE final and normal safety gates. Technical spec/plan/apply decisions use the 2026-11-15 delegated mandate with explicit provenance; the root integrator centrally reconciles current XML, archives and delivers after successful gates.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Parsed cache paths/key namespaces tied to Cargo's actual target directory; preserved workflow controls; existing supported backend matrix; subsequent normal cache restore/reuse logs with explicit unexecuted production boundaries.

Assumptions.Assumption: A cache is an optimization. Missing or stale entries must fall back to ordinary Cargo compilation, with all correctness checks unchanged.
